notes: DiscoFlate v3.64.0 — the Dashboard is gone and its parts moved to where they're used: Go Live Options and the session overlays now live on Scenes and belong to the SCENE, Leaderboards moved to Game, the Activity log to System, and the capacity slider and operator controls to Chat. Each scene carries its own intro, after-group, notify overlay and pause overlay, so switching scenes switches the whole show — no more one global intro pointing at groups that only exist in another scene. Existing configs migrate: your live scene inherits your current settings verbatim.
